# NewCo Studio

> NewCo Studio is a small web studio based in Oxfordshire, UK. It builds fixed-price websites, landing pages, Python automations and Excel/Google Sheets fixes for small businesses, with a written fixed quote within 24 hours. Prices are in GBP (£).

## Services and prices (GBP)
- One-page website (responsive, mobile-first): £99 fixed
- Multi-page website: from £249
- Fix on an existing website, spreadsheet (Excel, Google Sheets) or Python script: from £19
- Email templates and small automations: quoted fixed in writing

## Process
1. Send a short written brief via the quote form: https://studio.newcopacks.co.uk/#quote
2. Receive a written fixed quote (scope, price, delivery date) within 24 hours.
3. Work is built; revisions are agreed up front.
4. Client receives all source files and owns the code; domain and hosting stay in the client's name.
Work is done in writing (email or Upwork); no calls, no hourly billing.

## Location
Oxfordshire, United Kingdom. Serves UK clients and works worldwide remotely.
